metadata.case_name: SIU WAI CHEUNG ROCKY v. LEE WAI KWUN AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Wound to left lower leg (shin area)
source: He fell onto the tailgate with his left leg hitting onto it. His left leg was injured with a wound at the shin area.
injuries.icd_description: Open wound of knee or lower leg, unspecified

injuries.description: Infection of the wound requiring open drainage and suturing
source: His condition was later complicated by infection and a minor operation of open drainage of the pus was done on 22 October 2005. This resulted in suturing of the wound, and a week or so follow-up on wound care.

injuries.description: Scar with patch of tender discoloration of the left leg
source: At trial, the alleged residual problems resulting from the accident are occasional pain and cramping of the left leg, scar with patch of tender discoloration, discomfort and limitation in squatting, climbing and walking fast.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of knee or lower leg

injuries.description: Persistent occasional pain and cramping and limitation in mobility of the left leg
source: At trial, the alleged residual problems resulting from the accident are occasional pain and cramping of the left leg, scar with patch of tender discoloration, discomfort and limitation in squatting, climbing and walking fast.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at lower leg level

manifestations.description: tenderness, soft tissue swelling and minor skin abrasion over his left lower leg
pain and cramps in the left leg
scar with patch of tender discoloration
discomfort and limitation in squatting, climbing and walking fast

treatments_received: A & E wound dressing and analgesic medication
minor operation of open drainage of the pus and suturing

losses.description: discomfort and limitation in squatting, climbing and walking fast
scar with patch of tender discoloration of the left leg
occasional pain and cramping of the left leg
